title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics + parity fixes (v1.51.0)
author: Asha Patel
description: Context: This PR consolidates recent ergonomics work across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs: it unifies auth handling, normalizes retry/backoff semantics, and stabilizes streaming APIs to be feature-parity across languages. Motivation: downstream services and customers require consistent behavior (auth headers, retryable error classification, and streaming reconnect semantics) when switching languages or migrating from legacy SDKs. This PR groups a set of smaller changes that together enable a coordinated v1.51.0 release. What changed: - Auth: centralize token refresh logic and time-skew handling; add explicit refresh hooks for private deployments. - Retries: standardize transient error classification and backoff jitter across SDKs; expose retry config object in public constructors. - Streaming: harmonize API surface (on_message/on_close semantics), add resume token support in Python and Go to match TypeScript implementation. - Ergonomics: simplify constructors, add typed client factory helpers, and update examples/docs. - Parity/Version bumps: align API docs and bump package versions to v1.51.0 for all three SDKs. Testing and rollout: unit and integration tests added for auth and streaming; cross-language conformance tests run in benchmark-lab. CI: green on main matrix; one flaky e2e streaming test retried and stabilized. Rollout plan: merged to main, staged release artifacts for SDK package publishing pipeline. References: ENG-4312 (SDK parity), ENG-4398 (streaming resilience), SUP-2219 (customer incident prompting token-refresh fix).
commits: Initial implementation: centralize token refresh (sdk-python, sdk-ts, sdk-go)
Standardize retry policy and expose RetryConfig (sdk-python/ts/go)
Streaming: add resume token support and reconnect logic (python, go)
Docs and examples update: quickstarts and migration guide
Fix: handle clock skew during token refresh (edge case SUP-2219)
Bump versions to v1.51.0 and update CHANGELOG entries

release_notes:
- SDKs: unify auth token refresh + time-skew handling
- Standardize retry/backoff semantics and expose RetryConfig
- Stabilize streaming APIs and add resume tokens (Python & Go parity with TypeScript)
- Ergonomic client factories and updated examples
- Bump SDK versions to v1.51.0
notes_for_ops: Customers on Private deployments should verify KMS-integrated token refresh hook works with their key rotation schedule. Observability: added metrics 'sdk.auth.refresh_attempts' and 'sdk.stream.resume_attempts'.
migration_instructions: For most users: replace client constructor with new factory helper or pass RetryConfig; streaming consumers that relied on raw sockets should switch to the new streaming helper that exposes resume tokens. See docs/sdk-migration-v1.51.md for examples.
